description: Create or read a SIP address and private trunk credentials for one of the signed-in owner's answering lines. Any phone system that can send a call to a SIP address can send calls here with no phone number. SIP calls use the line's normal allowance or prepaid minutes, with no separate SIP price. Keep the returned username and password private. Needs lines:manage.
name: get_sip_address
title: Your line's SIP address
